notes: Store Home has a catalog-driven spotlight card above Featured & Recommended. Catalog v52 sets that spotlight to NOT TUBE: a full-width card that uses the existing NOT TUBE hero art fitted whole, opens the NOT TUBE product page, and has the usual Install / Open action. The Featured & Recommended split of PIKNOTT CELESTIKA and PIKNOTT SAPPHIRE is unchanged. Offline, the built-in fallback also shows the NOT TUBE spotlight. This build also bundles the PIKNOTT CELESTIKA cover so that half of the split card is not cropped on first run.
